description:
The image depicts the interior of a portable toilet, characterized by a light blue color and featuring two toilet paper dispensers attached to the walls. The toilet itself is gray and has a black lid, accompanied by a metal handrail at the top. The floor of the toilet is composed of a gray material.

* A portable toilet with a light blue color:
	+ The toilet is made of a lightweight, durable material.
	+ The blue color gives the toilet a clean and hygienic appearance.
